messages:
Cara: Heads-up: enterprise POC hit 413 when sending a 5MB combined convo+attachments payload into chat.generate. They need a demo tomorrow and can't refactor their client.
Pranav: Which model/endpoint? 5MB sounds larger than our 2MB gateway limit for hosted.
Cara: redwood-chat-32k via hosted API. Error text: 413 Request Entity Too Large from the ingress.
Eli: If they're using a browser client, they might be hitting proxy limits too. Ask for the raw `Content-Length` and the request headers.
Cara: Asked for headers. They responded: `Content-Length: 5234120`, `Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8`. No gzip.
Sami: Ok gateway-level block. Options for a quick demo: 1) presigned upload + context_url pointer, 2) gzip body + Content-Encoding (if supported), 3) client-side quick chunking (split into messages) or 4) temporary account-level gateway exception.
Cara: Customer can't change client code except a single quick tweak. They prefer presign if we can provide a short how-to.
InfraBot: prod-gw: upstream returned 413. log: "client=52.34.12.9 invalid request: payload too large"
Pranav: For hosted POC we can issue a short-lived presign via our ingestion helper. Security notes: presign should be PUT with expiry 10m, limited to a single key, and require TLS. We need to log the object_id in the POC ticket.
Eli: Share this minimal flow to customer: 1) POST /presign -> we return presigned URL 2) client PUT blob to that URL 3) client calls chat.generate with `{\"context_url\":\"<presigned>\", \"context_size\":5234120}`. Example: `curl -X PUT "<presigned>" --upload-file big_context.json -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream"`
Sami: Add note: hosted fetcher will stream and summarize on ingest to stay under model token limits. If they want full retrieval, that counts as model tokens at runtime.
Cara: Will presigned storage create extra costs or token billing issues? They asked billing question.
Pranav: Presigned upload has storage/network costs for them and transfer; redwood token billing only applies to tokens sent into the model. If we run an ingest summarization job on our side, that summarization will consume tokens and be billed. Recommend server-side pre-summary to reduce tokens.
Eli: Quick client tweak alternative: if their platform supports `Content-Encoding: gzip`, they can gzip the JSON body and reduce size 60-80% for text. Example (node): `const gz = zlib.gzipSync(JSON.stringify(payload)); fetch(api, {method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Encoding':'gzip'}, body:gz})`
Cara: Security team will want guarantees: presigned URL expiry, object ACL private, and an audit trail. Sami, can you confirm retention/TTL for presigns?
Sami: For POC we can set presign expiry 10 minutes and auto-delete object after 24 hours. We'll capture audit logs; Security should accept that for demo. For production recommend Dedicated with VPC storage.
Cara: They also worry about the model truncating long contexts even after upload. Any notes on sequence/token limits?
Pranav: Yes remind them: model token limit is 32k tokens for redwood-chat-32k. Large raw text may still be truncated; recommend semantic chunking + retrieval or incremental summarization before send. Provide a short heuristic: keep dense context under ~25k tokens to leave space for prompt + response.
Eli: Another quick hack: host an endpoint that returns only relevant sections (retrieve-by-keyphrase) and pass small pointers to the model. That is more work but scales better.
Cara: Customer timeline: needs something working for demo in ~16 hours. Which path is fastest?
Sami: Easiest: we generate presign (our helper) + they PUT the blob. We then run a small, automated summarizer on ingest and call the model with the short summary for the demo. I can provision the presign flow and the transient summarizer.
Pranav: If you go presign+summarize, please add a note to the billing: summarization tokens will be billed. Also prepare a fallback: if they still hit size limits, we can request a short gateway exception (Eli can queue).
Eli: I'll approve a temporary gateway body increase for this account if you send the account id + justification. Exception expires after demo window.
Cara: Sending account id now. Also forwarding the quick curl/gzip snippet and presign how-to. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
